function tryWasmBurn(s): void

Defined in: website/components/home/mosaic/burn/wasm.ts:164

Attempts the wasm mount: creates the stacked particle canvas (same class/box as the paper canvas — it paints above it by DOM order) and mounts the burn artifact on it with MANUAL drive — this module keeps the session's own RAF loop, so the bridge only initializes the surface. On any failure the 2D particle path simply keeps running.

Parameters

s

BurnSession

The live session — must already be laid out (syncPaper ran).
